title: Render submitted comments directly under the comment form

requirements.summary: Re-layout the Comments section so the comments list (including loading/empty states) renders immediately beneath the submission form in the same visual container/flow.
acceptanceCriteria: On the Comments section, the comment list renders immediately below the submission form area within the same visual flow (no large gap separating them).
The existing submit flow remains unchanged: submitting a comment clears the inputs and the newly submitted comment appears in the list after the posts query refreshes.
If there are no comments, the empty-state message is shown directly under the form.
Loading state for fetching comments is shown directly under the form.

file_operations.description: Update layout so the comments display block (header + loading/empty/list) is rendered directly beneath the form within the same Card/visual grouping; remove the large visual separation (e.g., reduce/remove the Card bottom margin and add a subtle divider/spacing between form and list). Keep existing React Query hooks and submit behavior unchanged (inputs clear on success, query invalidation refreshes list). Use existing shadcn-ui Card/CardContent/Button/Input/Textarea primitives already in use to maintain styling consistency—verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
